runs.shape: bond BEFORE the maze, no guard
runs.note: 14 of 15 clauses PASS -- inert_removal_priced, every_detour_relaid, pour_partition, no_regression, attributable_drc all TRUE

runs.shape: bond BEFORE the maze, switch-node lane reserved (3 discs)

runs.shape: NO bond; left to --repair-planes, which runs AFTER the maze

runs.shape: --escape-relief --relief-pad U21.4 --relief-extra-width 200000, bond left to the relief

escape_relief.why: the relief runs BEFORE the maze and offers only lands that are ALREADY orphans; U21.4 is still bonded by the pour at that moment, so it is a NO-OP here

levers_refused_on_the_merits.lever: narrow the switch node to 0.150 mm
levers_refused_on_the_merits.why: ACC_5V publishes 0.70 A ILIM in section 5; 0.150 mm carries 0.602 A at dT = 10 K

levers_refused_on_the_merits.lever: weaken the 0.300 mm SWITCH_NODE routed clearance
levers_refused_on_the_merits.why: a switching-aggressor separation, not an unchosen default
exactly one legal 0.60/0.30 mm site exists in the peninsula; r17 shows the next is 4.7 mm east, through the corridor both nets need

conclusion: the blocker is a FLOORPLAN fact: U21 is a SOT-563 whose GND, SW and VOUT lands are stacked on 0.500 mm pitch on the same side, all three must leave EAST, and the only inductor pad they can reach is 3.7 mm north behind a 0.98 x 3.70 mm land. The next transaction is a local re-floorplan of the U21 / L4 / C65 block in which U21.4 sits ON open B GND pour with room for TWO ground barrels and U21.5 faces L4.2 directly.
ordering_finding: the two primitives that could bond U21.4 sit on opposite sides of the maze and neither can be moved by a flag: --bond-pad and --escape-relief run BEFORE it (so a bond placed then owns the switch node's corridor, and the relief sees no orphan yet), and --repair-planes runs AFTER it (so the switch node already owns the corridor and no barrel site survives).
